title: Intel, Oracle, IBM join growing list of firms objecting to OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
reason: Major named firms (Intel, Oracle, IBM) formally objecting to a tokenized-stock SEC framework test is a significant regulatory development with two corroborating sources.

sources.summary: The latest notice added four objections, bringing the total to 26 as the joint venture prepares to test the SEC’s new framework for blockchain-based stock trading.
More than 40% of the companies initially proposed to have their stocks listed in tokenized form have asked to opt-out.

title: Nasdaq-100 comes onchain as Janus Henderson and Centrifuge launch first licensed fund
reason: First licensed onchain Nasdaq-100 fund from a $500B asset manager is a notable tokenization milestone with two sources.

sources.summary: The $500 billion asset manager is launching an issuer-sponsored fund on Stellar, taking a different approach from third-party stock tokens.
The blockchain-based fund offers eligible non-US investors exposure to the Nasdaq-100 as Janus Henderson expands its institutional tokenization business.
